fusions.name: Inkwing Flutter
fusions.desc: Looses a small folded flier into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Unheard Shriek
fusions.desc: Shrieks at a pitch too high to hear, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. The damage ignores resistances, and each enemy hit is left [Muddled] for 6 seconds, slowing its casting.

fusions.name: Colony Between Covers
fusions.desc: Calls a colony of folded fliers. For 12 seconds it harries an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Night Edition
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
